forecast_results.interpretation: consumed-day feasibility only; fitted model includes market logit offset at inference

inventory_shadow.interpretation: neutral hypothetical inventory shadow; not actual strategy PnL or executable liquidity guarantee
inventory_shadow.notional: 25 shares per side, separately; mean opportunity value, never sum anchors into a trading return

cancellation_stress.interpretation: One consumed day, uniform p99 reservation-release delay; no confidence interval or calibrated live-OMS claim. Each arm starts with zero realised PnL.

latency.interpretation: request to strategy-visible cancellation confirmation; completed cancels only, not physical venue removal
latency.stress: all cancellations reserve until the measured p99; physical removal remains original 22ms/pending95ms; diagnostic not calibrated simulation

limitations: Strategy guards trained on eight of the nine consumed replay dates; in-sample comparison, not expected live return.
Chronological forecast fits use earlier, available venue labels; all dates were already consumed, no new validation claim.
Neutral scheduled inventory opportunities, not selected fills; shadow dollar values are per opportunity, not summed strategy PnL.
Fixed delays and execution approximation omit full live OMS/watchdog parity and own market impact.
Loss budget carries realised PnL across studied dates but skips unstudied gaps; no continuous live-path claim.
Budget state credits simulated settlement at window completion, without a separate venue settlement-confirmation delay.
Cancellation stress is one day at a uniform completed-cancel p99, not an empirical latency replay; missing acknowledgements remain censored.
Nonlinear and cancellation stress extensions were declared after initial results; both explicitly exploratory.
Expanded forecast and inventory reports supersede initial inference, correcting max-T to use a sign-invariant scale; original point forecasts and valuations are unchanged.
Paired uncertainty clusters by day; six forecast test days give weak inference. Matched random controls are conditional nulls, not performance intervals.
Rebates excluded from trading PnL and the loss budget; $150 remains a test scenario, independent of the 150-share exposure cap.
